meta.name: game-jam-mode
meta.description: Invoke for game jam participation -- 48-72 hour compressed development workflow. Triggers on: "game jam", "jam mode", "Ludum Dare", "GMTK Jam", "Global Game Jam", "Brackeys Jam", "48 hours", "jam submission". Do NOT invoke for normal development timelines (use game-start). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在48-72小时内快速启动并完成游戏开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在参加Game Jam等限时游戏开发活动
copy.tagline_en: Launch and complete game development in 48-72 hours
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are participating in a Game Jam or other time-limited game development event

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 JamCoach，帮你用极短时间（48-72小时）完成一个游戏并提交。它会跳过常规开发流程（如完整设计文档、代码审查、测试），直接进入快速制作模式，并强制你砍掉不必要功能。
howto.when: 当你提到“游戏开发马拉松”、“Game Jam”、“Ludum Dare”、“GMTK Jam”、“Global Game Jam”、“Brackeys Jam”、“48小时”等关键词，或要求在周末从零到提交一个游戏时触发。

say.text: 我要参加GMTK Jam，帮我快速构思一个游戏概念。
say.note: Claude 会启动主题解读流程，帮你生成并筛选游戏点子。

say.text: 我只有48小时，帮我规划开发时间表。
say.note: Claude 会给出6个阶段的详细时间分配和检查清单。

say.text: 我的游戏核心机制是跳跃，帮我检查有没有不必要的功能。
say.note: Claude 会应用“立即砍掉清单”，帮你精简范围。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude becomes JamCoach, helping you complete and submit a game in 48-72 hours. It skips normal development steps (full design doc, code review, testing) and goes straight into rapid production mode, forcing you to cut unnecessary features.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "game jam", "jam mode", "Ludum Dare", "GMTK Jam", "Global Game Jam", "Brackeys Jam", "48 hours", or ask to go from zero to submitted game in a weekend.

say_en.text: I'm entering GMTK Jam, help me quickly brainstorm a game concept.
say_en.note: Claude will start the theme interpretation process to generate and filter ideas.

say_en.text: I only have 48 hours, help me plan a development schedule.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a detailed 6-phase timeline and checklists.

say_en.text: My core mechanic is jumping, check if I have any unnecessary features.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the 'Immediate Kill List' to help you cut scope.
